ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and both sides are defeated by the same gap. This is a NO_SHOW_CHARGE dispute over SGD 6.00, and the artefact that every operative test reads — the GPS trace, EV-GPS-09109 — is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, no payload). I can neither uphold the fee nor refund it, so the SGD 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded while a human reviewer settles it.

DRIVER — what I accept. (1) POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are met on the trip record: an 'arrived' event at 21:10:20 (limb (a)), and termination by you at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event (limb (d)). (2) The amount is correct: under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 6.00, and EV-FARE-09109 reconciles with it, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. (3) POL-NS-04 is indeed closed and gives the rider no full refund: her 21:11:30 message 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' is a locating statement within limb (a), but you replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45, fifteen seconds later and far inside the 120 seconds limb (b) allows. (4) POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 cannot run without a trace, and EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable — you are not caught by POL-NS-05, but you also cannot use limb (i) to accumulate dwell.

DRIVER — what I do not accept. Your POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c). Limb (b) requires the gps_trace itself to place the vehicle inside the 150 m Woodlands MRT hub geofence at or before the arrival event; limb (c) measures the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, expressly 'not from the arrived event'. The 320-second bracket between arrived_at 21:10:20 and cancelled_at 21:15:40, and wait_time_min of 5.3, are your own marker — the clause refuses to measure dwell from them — and the chat messages 'I am at the private-hire bay' (21:10:40) and 'I am here beside the sign' (21:11:45) are your own contemporaneous assertions, not an in-geofence measurement. With the trace absent, limbs (b) and (c) are UNDECIDED, not satisfied, and because POL-NS-01 is conjunctive the SGD 6.00 is not established as chargeable under it. Your anti-farming record is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; rate 1/120 = 0.008, below 0.08), so nothing is withheld against you — but that does not rescue the fee.

RIDER — what I accept. Your reading of POL-NS-01(b) is right as far as it goes: the fee cannot be substantiated, and you are not to be charged on limbs the driver cannot prove. You correctly do not press POL-NS-04. I also accept that no behaviour-based escalation trigger fires: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. Only the citable counters named by the clauses were used; no context-only profile field carried any finding (POL-GEN-01).

RIDER — what I do not accept. That the absent trace entitles you to a full refund. Absence is the limiting case of an impaired test, not proof the driver was elsewhere. POL-NS-02 (arrival geofence), POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance, which also needs coordinates placing the vehicle within 400 m) and POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall) all read GPS facts this record does not contain; an undecided limb supports neither a charge that needs the clause to hold nor a refund that needs it to fail.

THE DECIDING FACT AND CONFIDENCE. Where the vehicle was, and for how long, during the waiting window would be carried only by EV-GPS-09109, which is MISSING at weight 0.0. The driver's counterparty statement ('the GPS export is unavailable') carries no weight_multiplier, enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence cap, and no clause in this category names a counterparty statement as the test for the arrival or dwell limbs. Confidence is therefore capped at 0.0, below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, and the sole candidate evidence for the deciding fact is absent. Under POL-NS-09(a) and POL-NS-09(e) the case is ESCALATED: no money moves, and the SGD 6.00 is held. Open question for the reviewer: can the driver-side or platform-side GPS export for 20:59–21:16 on 9 September be produced, and if so does it place the vehicle within 150 m of the pickup pin continuously for 300 seconds? No referral is made: no clause that produces one fires — POL-NS-05(ii) requires a demonstrated absence of any qualifying in-geofence fix, which a missing trace does not establish, and POL-NS-07's escalation-packet instruction applies only where the anti-farming check trips, which it does not.
